repo_purpose: Cross-platform icon-theme asset, conversion, platform-output, documentation, and proof project for Windows 11 and Arch Linux/KDE Plasma.
primary_languages_and_tooling: Python asset conversion and validation scripts
Pillow for image processing when source images are present

work_management.technical_truth: Current repository source, configuration, mappings, scripts, assets, and verification evidence.
work_management.operational_truth: Current GitHub Issues and pull requests.

source_areas.purpose: Accepted raster master icons for the current asset batch.
Generated normalized PNG files by size.
Generated Windows ICO outputs by context.
CSV routing and platform target manifests.
Conversion, validation, dry-run, apply, and rollback scripts.

docs_safe_checks: Markdown relative-link scan over changed documentation
mutating_proof_command_notes: Conversion commands with --apply write generated assets.
Contact-sheet rendering with --apply writes generated contact sheets.
Validation and dry-run proof commands can append to or rewrite files under proof/.
scripts/validate/validate_mappings.py currently rewrites proof/known-gaps.md with obsolete skeleton-era text; see GitHub Issue #7 before using it to regenerate current proof.
safety_rules: Preserve product behavior unless the work item explicitly asks to change it.
Do not run live OS apply or apply-rollback commands without an explicit user request.
An apply gate is an authorization guard, not proof of safe behavior.
Do not edit or regenerate VERSIONS/ release archives unless explicitly requested.
Preserve unrelated dirty and untracked work.
Do not merge, deploy, publish, release, or tag unless explicitly authorized.
Treat current source/configuration and verification evidence as higher technical truth than documentation when conflicts appear.
sensitive_path_rules: Do not include secrets, credentials, tokens, private keys, private URLs, account identifiers, .env contents, or sensitive local paths in docs or indexes.
Do not add Obsidian sync, cloud sharing, account coupling, encryption setup, or company integrations unless explicitly requested.

obsidian_conventions.canonical_links: Use normal Markdown links in committed docs.
obsidian_conventions.wiki_links: Use sparingly in 00_Index.md for local graph navigation.

known_risks: Linux apply can mutate the user theme before all required desktop-override inputs are validated; GitHub Issue #2.
Windows apply does not yet conform to the accepted stable-icon-storage and lossless-rollback contract; GitHub Issue #3.
Apply/rollback safety lacks non-destructive regression coverage; GitHub Issue #4.
Current captured proof lacks a Windows PowerShell dry-run execution; GitHub Issue #5.
Unmapped exporter contexts can fall back to unrelated assets; GitHub Issue #6.
Mapping validation can overwrite current known-gap evidence with obsolete skeleton text; GitHub Issue #7.
A protected WinRAR archive change on current main requires provenance review; GitHub Issue #8.
No repository license, Code of Conduct, or private security-reporting route is selected/published; GitHub Issue #11.
There is no package manifest, Makefile, CI workflow, or unit-test framework.
